args.subject: Private Dining Reservation Request – Table for 12 on Friday, May 24, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a private dining table for 12 guests on Friday, May 24, 2024.

Reservation details:
- Date: Friday, May 24, 2024
- Party size: 12 guests
- Preferred time: 7:00 PM (we are happy to be flexible within your dinner service hours of 6:00–10:00 PM)
- Occasion: A private group dinner
- Estimated price per person: €30, as listed on your website

If you have any dietary requirements or menu options available for vegetarian and gluten-free guests, please let us know. We would also appreciate confirmation of availability and any deposit or pre-fixe requirements.

Please reply to this email or reach me at +1 327-420-4923.

Thank you for your consideration. We look forward to dining with you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
+1 327-420-4923
